name: virality_predictor
description: Virality Predictor predicts a video's virality potential, engagement, attention, audience response, retention risk, hook strength, and creative performance with an interactive dashboard. Use when the user asks whether a video can go viral or wants creative-performance analysis. Create starts analysis from a confirmed uploaded video or completed generated video; preview re-opens an existing dashboard.

action.description: create starts Virality Predictor analysis; preview re-opens an existing dashboard.

model.description: Required fixed model identifier for Virality Predictor.

job_id.description: Existing Virality Predictor job ID for action="preview".

id.description: Confirmed video media_id or completed generated video job_id.

params.description: Virality Predictor parameters. create uses medias; preview uses job_id.
